    Golden ticket

    Multiplayer · beta

    What's different in co-op

    • 2–4 players online. One player creates a room and shares the code, the others join.
    • Your own survivor. You bring your skin with its bonus and drawback, skill tree and special skill. Everything you earn counts for your account.
    • Shared level, your own cards. At a level-up the game pauses for everyone and each player picks their own cards (20 s).
    • Team crates. Whoever opens a crate opens it for everyone – each player gets their own picks.
    • Revive instead of game over. Fallen players become ghosts. Stand next to them for 3 s to bring them back – each further revive in the same stage takes longer. Nobody comes within 30 s? They bleed out and return next stage. The run ends when everyone is down.
    • More enemies. Enemy numbers, HP and bosses scale with the number of players.
    • Team perks. Five co-op-only perks like Rally or Lifeline. Cards that change the whole world (Fresh Meat, Swarm Call, Greed, Hunted) are solo only.
    • Pause together. Press Tab to ask for a pause – the game pauses once everyone agrees.
    • Between stages everyone has up to 60 s to spend skill points.
    • Own stats and leaderboard. Co-op runs are listed separately and can't be saved and resumed.
    Online co-op · beta

    Shift together

    2–4 players. Everyone plays their own survivor with their own skin and skill tree. You level up together and each picks their own cards.

              Service rank
              Unlocks
              
    
              
    
              
    
              
      
              
    
              
    
              
    
              How unlocking works
      
              Every run that clears at least stage 1 earns service XP. Every new level is a draw: one random locked weapon, perk or evolution becomes yours. Only items that fit what you already have can be drawn: an evolution needs its base weapon, a perk needs at least one fitting weapon. Fusion recipes unlock as soon as both ingredients are unlocked. Locked items never show up on level-up cards.
              
      
              Your start weapon is always available. Test runs do not count. The rank resets with every new season.

                How the preview works
                
    
                  
      
                • 2 stagesMap Magma Springs with the new hero, the Volcanologist, and his magma pick.
                  • 
      
                • PRESSTop left. Fills with melee hits – when it is full, the ground erupts around you and hurls lava bombs.
                  • 
      
                • HEATRises with every melee hit: more damage, faster swings, healing. It cools down after 3 s without melee.
                  • 
      
                • New itemsThe new Season 2 item system is active.
                  • 
      
                • After the runService rank XP and a draw – then please tell us what you think.
